none: PAS SUSS-634576: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine II as Caesar
contea di ritrovamento: East Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy Roman nummus of Constantine II as Caesar, dating from AD 322-323 (Reece period 16). BEATA TRAN-QVILLITAS reverse type, depicting a globe set on altar inscribed with 'VOT/IS/XX' in three lines, surmounted by three stars above. Mint of Trier. Cf. RIC VII, p. 198, no. 382
